summary: Improve parcel discovery, valuation, billing, and collection controls. Explore practical municipal property-tax training and plan your next steps.
lede: Municipal property tax training helps finance, valuation, revenue, GIS and land-information staff link property records to revenue operations. Participants map parcel-discovery gaps with GIS, assess valuation evidence, reconcile assessment rolls with billing files in Excel, and build controls for collection monitoring. They also develop taxpayer-contact workflows and a staged reform roadmap to support accountability and prioritize feasible improvements.
audienceIntro: This course suits practitioners responsible for municipal property records, assessment, billing, revenue collection, or local-government reform. It is designed for staff who need to connect technical records with finance operations and public accountability.
prerequisites: Prior work in municipal finance, property valuation, revenue administration, GIS, land information, or local-government reform is recommended. No programming is required. Bring familiarity with the records or processes you support, where available; exercises also use structured case examples.
